cmd.uploadClipboardAs.title: Upload Clipboard Image As…
cmd.uploadClipboardAs.description: Pick the insert format (Markdown / HTML center / HTML figure) for this upload only.
cmd.uploadFile.title: Upload Image File
cmd.configure.title: Configure Settings
config.provider.description: Storage provider. Currently only `r2` is wired in; S3/OSS/COS are roadmap items.
config.pathTemplate.description: Path template for uploaded objects. Available variables: {yyyy} {MM} {dd} {hh} {mm} {ss} {timestamp} {random} {name} {ext}.
config.maxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels; images wider than this are downscaled before encoding. Set to `0` to keep original dimensions.
config.quality.description: WebP quality (1-100). Higher = larger files, better fidelity.
config.autoInstallSharp.description: When `sharp` is missing, prompt to install the native binary on first use. Requires Node.js ≥ 18.17 and `npm` on PATH.
config.disableCompressionNotice.descript: Suppress the warning shown when the sharp compression engine is unavailable.
config.insertFormat.description: How to render the image snippet that gets inserted into the editor. `markdown` / `html-center` / `html-figure` / `custom`. See README §Insert format templates.
config.insertWidth.description: Width attribute used in {width} for HTML templates. e.g. `65%`, `600px`, `auto`. Empty = omit the width attribute.
config.insertAlign.description: Alignment for HTML templates. `none` skips the wrapper <div>.
config.insertCustomTemplate.description: Custom insert template used when ezimage.insertFormat = 'custom'. Variables: {url} {filename} {name} {ext} {width} {align} {alt}.
config.insertIncludeName.description: Use the source filename as the alt text / figcaption. Ignored if insertCustomAlt is set.
config.language.description: Display language for EzImage prompts, errors, and info messages. `auto` follows VS Code's display language.
